Remark
[Chern--Kuiper generalization] ↗ thm:dc-ch10-3-1 1. ch10:3.7Let $M^n$ be compact and suppose each $T_pM$ contains an $m$-dimensional subspace $V$ on which all sectional curvatures are nonpositive. If $k<m$, there is no isometric immersion $M^n\to \mathbb R^{n+k}$.
